notes: Writer's doubt settled: El Sleezo Cafe is named on screen (Kermit: 'The El Sleezo Cafe. Hmm, Foreign food.') and the owner's pest hole line is verbatim on Wikiquote, so the venue and note stand. Fozzie bombs there (ToughPigs). Steve Martin's waiter serves the sparkling muscatel at a different restaurant (Wikipedia: where Rowlf plays piano), so the Idaho fizz line is true but is not an El Sleezo moment. Stubs: house 'Hot salted chips: Potatoes only.' reads cut short and 'Swamp-green lime cordial' prints with no line. No dashes, every drink alcohol-free.

vibe.verdict: The El Sleezo is a smart, real venue and the big beats print, but the house lines are stubs and the copy is plainer than the film's puns.
